# Swapnil — AI Engineer

> AI Engineer with 2.5+ years shipping LLM-powered products into production across fintech and media platforms. Owns features end-to-end — from retrieval and agent design to deployment and monitoring on AWS — delivering double-digit cost savings and 10x faster workflows.

## Current role

Senior Data Scientist at Kissht (Si Creva Capital Services), Gurugram, India.

## Expertise

- GenAI & LLM: RAG, agentic & multi-agent workflows (LangGraph, LangChain), function calling, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, MCP, Hugging Face, LangSmith, MLOps
- ML & Data: embeddings, vector search, OCR & document processing, model serving (MLflow), Pinecone, FAISS
- Languages: Python, C++, Go, SQL
- Data & Cloud: MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Snowflake, Elasticsearch, AWS (Lambda, SageMaker, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, CloudWatch)
- DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Kafka, Airflow, Microservices, Distributed Systems

## Selected work

- ML-Central: Dockerized single source of truth for feature & model code — cut infra costs 40% across 15+ models
- NLP-driven global search service handling 50K+ daily requests, query latency 10s → 2s
- Multi-agent sourcing service (LangGraph + Crawl4AI) automating newsletters & RSS across 400K+ companies
- Real-time MLOps observability on Amazon ECS, reducing undetected failures by 85%
